correctness.rationale: The checked kernel of TT* is the length of the common rooted-path prefix. Direct diagonal and squared-kernel integrals give ||T||_S2²=L²[m-(m-1)t²]/2 and the displayed fourth moment with derivative 2(m-1)t[(6m-1)t²-9mt+3m]/3. Independent SymPy manipulation recovered both identities and the unique S4 interior root, checked at m=2,3,4,8,13. For the infinite-dimensional operator norm, identify T as inverse of rooted Sobolev differentiation: radial Dirichlet–Neumann–Kirchhoff eigenvalue root F(k,a)=((m+1)cos(kL)-(m-1)cos(k(2a-L)))/2 has strictly negative k-derivative over (0,π/(2L)] and at fixed k is uniquely smallest at t=1/2; transverse first eigenvalue is no smaller. This yields the unique 1/2 operator-norm optimizer with value L/[2 arctan(m^-1/2)]. Endpoint collapsed edges and m>=2 verified; numerical Nyström checks are only corroboration, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Relies on standard compact Sobolev-to-L2 variational characterization and radial/transverse spectral decomposition; not formal Lean proof.
